summary: First test iteration for Salon SaaS platform. Backend: 38 pytest cases covering auth (all 5 roles), dashboard, agenda/availability (incl. Sunday-closed for Zona 10), booking + status + reschedule + 409 conflict, CRM, loyalty, marketing, reports, audit, admin SaaS (metrics/companies/billing-run/export/payments/non-super-forbidden), signup (success + duplicate), public portal (salon/slots/book/my/cancel), waitlist, WhatsApp inbound simulator (incl. Claude bot reply ~2-3s), role restrictions (stylist-only, receptionist 403 on /services), and full suspension flow (status=suspended->portal 403 & WA suspension msg; status=suspended_partial->company writes 402; restored). All 38 pass. Frontend: Smoke-tested login flows for super_admin (→/admin, MRR cards visible), company_admin (→/app), stylist (→/app/agenda, sees only own column), agenda page loads with Nueva cita, public portal /b/bellavida renders, signup page renders.

minor.issue: If the client sends a non-string 'time' (e.g. a dict by mistake) the engine crashes with 500 in alternatives() instead of 400. Add type/format validation on body['time'] (expect 'HH:MM') to return 400.

issues: Recharts prints repeated console warnings 'width(-1) and height(-1)' for ResponsiveContainer wrappers - add minWidth/minHeight or a fixed aspect to the chart containers.

action_items: (Minor) Validate 'time' format in POST /api/appointments and /api/public/salon/{slug}/book (and reschedule) to return 400 instead of 500 when non-string/invalid.
(Minor) Fix Recharts ResponsiveContainer warnings on admin dashboard by giving the parent explicit min-height.
No critical fixes required; backend and primary flows all pass.
critical_code_review_comments: engine.py:14 m() has no defensive check for non-string input - any upstream bug feeds a dict and causes 500 cascade; add isinstance guard or Pydantic validation at route level.
routes_ops.py:244 /appointments uses dict Body(...) without Pydantic model - no input validation layer; same for most other routes. Consider Pydantic models for type safety.
Several large modules (routes_ops.py 427 lines, engine.py 281) are approaching the 700-line split threshold - still OK but monitor as features grow.
Mongo _id is always excluded via project in find() (good); confirmed no _id leaks in responses sampled.
Dashboard uses MM/DD date in UI but ISO yyyy-mm-dd in API - consistent.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of smoke flows (login x3 roles, dashboards, agenda, portal, signup)

test_credentials: Loaded from /app/memory/test_credentials.md (super admin + 4 bellavida demo users).
seed_data_creation: Tests create ephemeral TEST_ prefixed records (companies via signup, clients, appointments, waitlist). All cleaned up after the run; bellavida demo restored to status=active with all 10 modules enabled.
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py must run with -n 0 (serial) because TestSuspension mutates demo company state; the pytest.ini default -n 2 --dist loadscope causes races between TestSuspension and TestPublicPortal/TestAgenda/TestWhatsApp. Command: `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/backend_test.py -n 0 --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml`. If re-running, note that TEST_ companies and TEST_ clients/appointments/waitlist should be cleaned via the Mongo cleanup snippet in iteration_1 (see summary). Public URL used for all testing is REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from frontend/.env.
rca of the issue: No production bugs blocking features. Minor 500→400 defensive validation suggested for appointment booking time format (reproducible by POSTing {time: {...}} but UI always sends a string, so not user-facing).
